subject.title: [Feature]: Reusable gateway WebSocket client SDK package

question: Should OpenClaw publish and support a public Gateway WebSocket client SDK now, and should that contract be the raw @openclaw/gateway-client package, the higher-level @openclaw/sdk, or both?
rationale: Current code contains private internal packages and public docs intentionally warn users not to depend on them; turning either package into a public SDK requires maintainer API, versioning, publication, and security-boundary intent.

options.title: Sponsor public SDK design
options.body: Keep this issue open and define the supported package name, adapter model, auth/storage contract, docs, and proof bar before publishing anything.

options.title: Fold into App SDK roadmap
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/74704 the canonical public-app path and explicitly defer or reject a raw gateway-client package.

options.title: Defer public SDK
options.body: Keep external consumers on documented Gateway protocol/RPC and close this later only if maintainers decide no official client package is planned.

recommendation.title: Sponsor public SDK design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define the supported package name, adapter model, auth/storage contract, docs, and proof bar before publishing anything.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the internal package extraction and current app-SDK package surface most directly implicated by the package-publication choice.
